views.rationale: Decomposition (2.1 Decomposition Style) covers decomposition; combined with layered (V&B 6.6) because the repository is layered (Boundary/Control/Entity/Database), which covers layering

Component-and-Connector (Ch. 3 Component-and-Connector Views) covers collaboration and dependencies; stays generic because the repository shows none of the signals of a C&C style (no rest-api, services, event-bus, peer-calls, data-flow, shared-repository); combined with layered (V&B 6.6)

notes: Candidates covering a primary need: decomposition (decomposition), uses (dependencies), layered (layering, decomposition), cnc-generic (collaboration, dependencies). Sets of 1 view cannot cover all four needs.

Best 2-view sets all cover the four needs (layering via the layered overlay for decomposition/uses/cnc-generic). Ties on secondary needs (none covered), framed needs (2), role prior (2) are broken by catalog position: decomposition+cnc-generic (1+7) beats layered+cnc-generic (4+7).
The layering need is assigned to V1 because V1 carries the layered overlay that covers it.
data-structure and data-storage are secondary and add no view; the data-model and data-stores viewpoints were not selected.
